messages:
Anya (PM): quick sync — post-launch: we need a compact plan for the next 2 weeks to decide what gets hotfixed vs what goes to the next enhancement wave. thinking: clear glue rules + a single mini-sprint for high-impact bugs.
Sam (ENG): +1. can we get a list of top regressions and customer-facing errors? hard to triage without impact data.
Lee (SRE): throwing p99 latency spikes and one memory leak on the list. ops saw three regressions flagged by synthetic tests at 03:20 yesterday.
Maria (TPM): customer signal: two customers reported inference timeouts that affect webhooks. also a feature request from a customer who paid for dedicated capacity. priority unclear.
Anya (PM): proposal: define P0 = outages + data loss + revenue-impacting; P1 = regressions causing >5% error rate or >250ms added p95 for core flows; everything else is backlog. agree?
Sam (ENG): sounds good. for P0/P1 we should reserve a 20% engineering slice for hotfix work for the next 2 weeks. otherwise we won't get anything shipped.
Lee (SRE): 20% is tight but doable. need a rollback/runbook for each hotfix. can we commit to canary + 1h observation before full rollout?
Anya (PM): yes — must have canary + smoke checks. Maria, can you own the release checklist and customer comms for any P0?
Maria (TPM): I can. I'll prepare a short template: impact summary, mitigation steps, customer-facing note. will also tag impacted customers and owners.
Sam (ENG): for dev coordination — recommend we create an "iter-mini-hotpatch" label and a short PR template with "fix-or-enhance" flag. example snippet for deploy steps:
```
# quick canary
./deploy --service=inference --image=canary --canary=10
# run smoke suite
./smoke-check --route=/generate --qps=5
```
Lee (SRE): add an SLO check: if errors or p95 regress after canary, auto-roll back. we can wire that into deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary job created: job_id=canary-1799993333, watches: p95_latency, error_rate.
Anya (PM): decision rule for backlog: if a bug is not P0/P1 but has >30 upvotes from customers or affects a core metric (CTR, revenue, retention) then it moves to next wave. else it waits.
Maria (TPM): will gather votes and metric deltas. I'll post a short doc with the list + recommended tagging by EOD.
Sam (ENG): timeline: today — triage + label; tomorrow — owners assigned; day3-14 — 20% hotfix capacity; end of week2 — review outcomes and decide what lands in mainline sprint.
Lee (SRE): I'll add automated alerts to the triage channel so new regressions aren't missed.
Anya (PM): perfect. small checklist for this thread: 1) Maria publishes triage doc (EOD) 2) Sam/Leads carve 20% capacity and add label 3) Lee wires canary rollback hooks 4) I'll run the post-2-week review. :thumbsup:
Sam (ENG): ok, will create the label and PR template now.
Maria (TPM): posting triage doc shortly: <https://confluence.redwood.ai/postlaunch-triage-1799993333|triage doc>. will ping affected customer owners.
Lee (SRE): noted. I'll watch the deploy-bot job and share alerts in #eng-oncall.
Anya (PM): thanks team — followups in this thread. if anything urgent, DM.
